text:
maya: Quick announce: target deploy for SDK v4.2.0 + docs cookbook reorg tomorrow 10:00 PT. Two major things: (1) telemetry becomes explicit opt-in (default OFF) across hosted/dedicated/private; (2) docs samples are being normalized and relocated into /recipes/, with a required SPDX header for snippet licensing. Details below.

ellie: Can you explain the telemetry model? Is this just usage counters or payload capture?

maya: Telemetry will be minimal by default: only anonymized client-side metrics (latency buckets, success/failure counts, SDK version) and event hashes for certain errors. No request/response bodies or prompt storage unless a user explicitly sets `telemetry.collect_full=true` in config. Default remains OFF; we will require an explicit opt-in flag or env var `RWI_TELEMETRY=1`.

zach: Do we need legal sign-off for the license header change? Some customers embed snippets directly into apps.

maya: Legal confirmed Apache-2.0-SHORT (SPDX: Apache-2.0) is fine. We are adding a small header comment for every snippet and example file. The docs repo PR includes a script to insert the header into Python/JS/Go examples. The header is just one line: `// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0` or `# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0` for Python.

paula: How disruptive is the /recipes/ move? Will links break?

maya: We keep redirects for existing permalinks for 90 days. The cookbook home will show the mapping table and a migration guide. We renamed a few folders: `examples/` -> `recipes/` and `how-tos/` -> `recipes/quick-starts`. All internal docs links updated in the PR but external links will 302 -> new paths for 90 days.

docs-bot: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/438 "docs: recipes reorg + telemetry opt-in + snippet license headers"	1 changed files, includes `scripts/insert-spdx.py` and `rwi-cli docs-apply-license`. Linter rules added: SAMPLES_LICENSE_HEADER (docs-401) and TELEMETRY_OPT_IN_TEXT (docs-402).

zach: For telemetry opt-in wording in the README, please use the exact consent text. We need consistency for legal.

maya: Good call. PR contains canonical text in `telemetry.md` and a short consent snippet for SDK setup: ```python
# opt-in example
from rwi import Client
c = Client(telemetry={"enabled": True, "collect_full": False})
```

paula: Will the SDK change impact Dedicated/Private? Customers often disable outbound calls entirely.

maya: No outbound telemetry by default. Private deployments will have the same API surface but the client will detect internal config (env var `RWI_PRIVATE=true`) and disable network telemetry unless explicitly allowed. Dedicated clusters will also follow the same opt-in policy.

support-bot: Heads-up: created internal KB stub https://internal.redwood/support/kb/sdk-telemetry-opt-in for Support to populate.

ellie: Linter/CICD: we added SAMPLES_LICENSE_HEADER as a WARN for two weeks then ERROR. The docs pipeline will auto-run `rwi-cli docs-apply-license --check` and `--fix` is available. SDK repo CI will surface a note if snippets are missing header.

zach: Any CLI helpers for batch updates? Our integrations team wants a non-destructive mode.

maya: Yes: `rwi-cli docs-apply-license --check` (reports), `--fix` (patch files), and `--dry-run` (prints changes). We also added `rwi-cli telemetry-summary` to summarize opt-in usage across a repo (local scan) for teams. The tools will be in `rwi-cli@0.9.1`.

paula: Timeline?

maya: Rollout plan: publish docs + SDK tomorrow 10:00 PT, 90-day redirects for paths, 30-day soft warning on missing SPDX header (console banners for authors), linter WARN -> ERROR schedule: WARN for 14 days then ERROR. Telemetry: default OFF immediately; opt-in docs and consent snippets live at release.

ellie: Please add a short Console banner for docs authors: "New: snippet license headers required in 14 days. Use rwi-cli to fix." Can we enable that?

maya: Will add a Console banner targeted at docs and SDK repos.

docs-bot: Release notes draft: "SDK v4.2.0: telemetry opt-in default OFF; snippets standardized under /recipes; SPDX license header required; new rwi-cli helpers; redirects for 90 days; linter rules added." Link: https://internal.redwood/docs/releases/v4.2.0

release-bot: Publishing internal checklist: https://internal.redwood/releases/checklists/sdk-4-2-telemetry-recipes. Will email #all at 09:30 PT tomorrow with timeline and Support KB link.

zach: I'll do a quick sweep of all repo README examples tonight and run `--check` in dry-run.

paula: Thanks. Small ask: add a migration note for partners using embedded docs in onboarding flows. Some will need manual updates.

maya: Added note to the checklist. Thanks all — ping me if you find any snippets without a header or any legal wording issues.
